title: Amanitum
description: New items & effects. Makes game interesting again!
body:
This mod introduces new types of mushrooms and extracts to bring more interactivity to your world. Mushrooms are no longer limited to just soups — you can now process them in a furnace or consume them to gain special effects.

Each mushroom offers a unique effect. The mod also adds bundles and extracts: advanced items that provide more potent benefits but require more effort and resources to create. All about mod you can check below
